HOUSE RULES
Defaults that govern the year.
MINIMUM STAY
2 nights

3 nights on Fri–Sun across all bookable months.

CHECK-IN WINDOW
15:00 — 19:00

Self check-in by code outside these hours.

CANCELLATION
14 days

Full refund up until two weeks before arrival.

LEAD TIME
36 hours

Earliest booking window — until first arrival.

CHAPTER II
Seasons declared, then honoured.

Rather than fiddle with single nights, define four broad seasons and let them carry the pricing forward. Override only where the calendar — an exhibition opening, a regional holiday, the long quiet of February — asks for it.

FOUR SEASONS
Four moods, plotted across the year.
● Low — Sep through Nov

● Peak — June through August

Distributed, but never duplicated.

When you publish, the calendar pushes outward in three minutes — to the direct booking engine, to Airbnb, to the partner channels you've chosen to keep. Bookings sync inward in the opposite direction. No errand is ever a small mistakes.
